messages:
Alice (oncall): getting multiple alerts from the EU-dedicated pool, high 5xx rate and request timeouts. visible spike at 23:02 UTC. Affects two enterprise accounts we need to notify.
inc-bot: Created incident I-20260315-1123. Severity: P1. Pager: Alice, Ben.
Alice (oncall): Initial triage — error pattern is 503/timeout on model inference path, appears when sequence length > 4k for certain customers. Ben, can you pick this up? I'll start customer impact mapping.
Ben (eng-sre): on it. I see increased queue length on nodes gpu-eu-2 and gpu-eu-3. Logs show repeated "kv-cache lookup timeout" and gRPC stream cancellations.
Ben (eng-sre): running quick diag: `kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep gpu-eu` then `runcmd: ./diag/inference_qs.sh --target gpu-eu-2` — will post results.
Alice (oncall): Carla, please prepare customer comms. Priority list: 1) Meridian Autos (account-id: MDA-00987), 2) Novara Health (NOVA-3321). Both on Dedicated EU clusters and on higher-tier SLAs.
Carla (customer-success): ack. Drafting tailored notices. Quick template option: 
``
Subject: Service impact affecting your EU inference capacity
Hi <Customer>,
We're investigating elevated errors and request timeouts in the EU inference cluster that may impact live traffic. Our engineers are actively mitigating; we'll follow up with ETA and recommended mitigations.
Regards, Redwood Inference Support
``
I'll tailor both drafts, include contact routing and workaround steps.
Dinesh (ops): Mitigation note — we can route impacted customers to warm spare capacity in eu-west-2 (non-dedicated fallback) with degraded throughput but fewer timeouts. We need customer opt-in for fallback for Novara (compliance check). Meridian has opt-in already. Recommend enabling fallback for Meridian immediately.
Ben (eng-sre): Found a recent kernel regression in our KV-cache eviction path; patch candidate building now. If we can push a rollback on the runtime to yesterday's image (tag: rwd-infer:2026-03-14) we might restore stability quickly. Rollback will cause brief reconnections ~30s.
Alice (oncall): Approve rollback if Ben thinks safe. Post rollback command here and we will execute on gpu-eu-2/3 first as canary.
Ben (eng-sre): Rollback plan (canary):
``
# canary rollback to last stable image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-runtime inference-runtime=rwd-infer:2026-03-14 --record
# monitor logs for 2 minutes
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-runtime -f --tail=100 | sed -n '1,200p'
``
I'll run on gpu-eu-2 now, watch CPU/mem and request 5xx rate.
deploy-bot: deploy started by Ben on gpu-eu-2 at 23:11:45 UTC (deploy-id: dpl-2361234570).
Ben (eng-sre): Can confirm canary rollback succeeded on gpu-eu-2, 5xxs down to baseline in 90s. Starting rollout to gpu-eu-3.
Alice (oncall): Good. Carla — start sending customer notification for Meridian (they opted into fallback). Use this tailored text: 
``
Meridian Autos — Impact: Increased inference timeouts in EU dedicated cluster; traffic briefly failed to complete. Action: We are routing your traffic to fallback capacity and performing runtime rollback to restore stability. Expected impact: short reconnects (under 90s) and slightly higher latency until traffic returns to dedicated pool. No data loss.
Point of contact: carla@redwood.ai
``
Carla (customer-success): Sending now to Meridian ops distribution list. cc: account exec. Message sent at 23:13 UTC. Response: Meridian acknowledged, requested ETA for full return to dedicated pool.
Eve (support): For Novara Health, flagged compliance block for fallback to non-dedicated. Waiting on their SOC approval — emailed SOC@novara at 23:14 UTC. If they deny, we'll need to keep them on-dedicated and accept degraded service or schedule maintenance window.
Alice (oncall): Update for status page — we should post a short, neutral status entry for EU inference with affected customers list and mitigation. Suggest status text: 
``
[Investigating] Elevated error rates in EU inference cluster impacting a subset of dedicated customers. Engineers are rolling back runtime to a stable image and routing eligible customers to fallback capacity. Affected accounts: Meridian Autos, Novara Health (investigating fallback eligibility). We will provide updates within 30 minutes.
``
Ben (eng-sre): Rollout completed on gpu-eu-3 at 23:15:30, 5xxs trending down across cluster. Monitoring for 10 more minutes before confirmation. No regression observed so far.
inc-bot: Incident I-20260315-1123 status updated: mitigated -> partial; root cause suspected: runtime kv-cache regression in 2026-03-15 build. Next: postmortem and customer impact assessment.
Alice (oncall): On-call handoff reminder: I'm handing this to Ben for next 2 hours while I prep escalation notes for SRE lead. Ben please record mitigation timeline in the incident ticket and add a rollback annotation.
Ben (eng-sre): Recorded timeline:
- 23:02 Alert threshold breached
- 23:07 Initial triage and account mapping
- 23:11 Canary rollback started on gpu-eu-2
- 23:12 Canary stable
- 23:13 Rollout to gpu-eu-3 started
- 23:15 Rollout complete, errors decreasing
- 23:18 Monitoring in progress
I'll add to I-20260315-1123.
Carla (customer-success): Novara SOC responded: "we cannot route to non-dedicated without formal change request; please schedule maintenance." They've asked for a templated impact note for execs. Drafting now: 
``
Novara Health — Executive Impact Summary:
- Incident: Elevated timeouts on EU dedicated inference cluster between 23:02–23:15 UTC.
- Impact: Some API requests failed or retried; clinical workflow delays possible for queued jobs.
- Mitigation: Runtime rollback completed; Novara remains on dedicated capacity pending SOC approval.
- Next steps: Postmortem, recommended kernel fix rollout, and formal maintenance window coordination.
``
Carla (customer-success): Sending exec note to Novara ops and account team at 23:20 UTC.
Dinesh (ops): For internal comms, recommended internal status template (for all enterprise customers):
``
Severity: P1
Affected region: EU (dedicated pool)
Customer list: <list account ids>
Immediate action: rollback to stable runtime + optional fallback routing
ETA for full recovery: TBD (monitoring 30 min)
Contact: <cs rep email> / oncall@redwood.ai
``
Use that for quick copy-paste.
Alice (oncall): Closing notes — thank you team. Action items: Ben to continue monitoring and open PR for kv-cache fix; Dinesh to prepare rollback hotfix plan; Carla to follow up with Novara SOC and send customer post-incident summary once root cause confirmed. I'll update the incident channel and set status page to "identified & mitigated" once 30m stable.
Ben (eng-sre): Will open PR referencing I-20260315-1123 and tag for urgent review. If errors reappear, escalate to runtime lead immediately.
inc-bot: Incident I-20260315-1123 moved to status: monitoring (23:45 UTC). Logged notes added by Alice, Ben, Carla.
Carla (customer-success): Filed customer comms artifacts to the account folder: `/customer-notices/meridian/2026-03-15-incident.md` and `/customer-notices/novara/2026-03-15-exec-summary.md`.
Alice (oncall): End of thread for operational steps. Will reopen if we need active paging. :white_check_mark:
